metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to express dissatisfaction with the quality of the trial cleaning service they received. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I wanted to talk about the cleaning service I had last week. Hi Betty, it's nice to hear from you. I'm here to help. What seems to be the issue? Well, I wasn't happy with the quality of the cleaning service. They missed a lot of spots, and it just didn't feel thorough. I'm really sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what was missed? Sure, the bathroom wasn't cleaned properly, and there was dust still on the furniture. I expected better, especially after my last visit. I understand, and I apologize for the inconvenience. We strive for high standards. I appreciate that, but this was disappointing. I just want to ensure I get the care I’m paying for. Absolutely, Betty. I’ll make sure to address this with our cleaning team. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied. Thank you. I’d like to know if there’s a way to have a different team come next time. Yes, we can arrange that for you. Would you like me to note that for your next scheduled service? Yes, please. I'd appreciate a fresh start with a new team. Got it. I’ll make a note to assign a different cleaning team for your next appointment. Great, thank you! And what can I do if the issue persists? If you have any concerns, you can call me directly at +13165559201. I’ll ensure it gets resolved immediately. That sounds good. I’ll keep that in mind. Is there anything else I need to know? Just that we can also provide additional services, like personal care assistance or companionship, if you're interested. I might be interested in companion care. Can you send me info about that? Of course! I’ll email you the details about our companion care services. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You're welcome, Betty! I’m here to assist anytime. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
